summary: Request: Enable channel-lease workflow and metadata-sync bot for temporary project channels
description: Request to provision an automated channel lifecycle + metadata synchronization bot to manage short-lived Slack channels created by product and experiment pods. Goal: standardize lease-based archival, ensure Confluence index pages are created/updated with channel metadata, and keep group ownership in sync with Jira project groups.
impact: Improves hygiene on ephemeral channels, reduces orphaned channels and noise for SRE/Support, and ensures Confluence channel-indexing for discoverability and compliance. Lowers manual admin overhead for project leads.
request_details: 1) Install/configure a 'channel-lease' bot that: - Allows creators to request a lease when creating a channel (default 30 days). - Auto-archives channel at lease end unless extended via /extend or Jira INT ticket. - Posts lease metadata to channel topic and pins a lease summary.
additional_details: 2) Metadata-sync behavior: - When a lease is created, auto-create a Confluence page under 'Team Spaces / Ephemeral Channels' using a lightweight template. - Populate page with: channel name, owner group(s), description, creation date, lease end, associated Jira projects. - Update the page if lease is extended or channel archived.
permissions_and_scope: Bot requires scopes to create/update channels metadata, pin messages, create Confluence pages (Confluence API credentials), and read SCIM/group membership to map channel owners. Proposed OAuth scopes: chat:write, channels:manage, channels:read, users:read, admin.scim:read, confluence:content.write.
naming_and_defaults: Naming convention enforced by bot: pod-<pod-name>-<purpose>-<yyMMdd>. Default lease: 30 days. Expansion requests allowed to 90 days with manager approval. Admins can run /force-archive and /recreate-index commands.
compliance_requirements: Compliance (info-sec) review requested for Confluence auto-creation and retention labeling. Proposed retention label: ephemeral-channel-30d. Compliance contact: Maria Gomez.
steps_taken: Initial discovery: interviewed two product pods and Platform DX. Prototype discussed in #platform-automation. Scoped feature in experimental sandbox workspace (test workspace created: platform-ephemeral-test).
comments: Priya Nair (2026-03-11): Need bot installed for new experiment pods to avoid manual cleanup and to ensure a Confluence index entry exists for audits. Prefer default 30-day lease. Please advise required approvals and estimated lead time.

Ethan Cole (2026-03-11): Thanks Priya — tagging infra and security. Can you confirm whether the bot should create pages in a shared space or within each team's space? Also need SCIM group mapping details.

Priya Nair (2026-03-11): Prefer shared 'Ephemeral Channels' space to avoid sprawl. For group mapping: map Jira project lead group (jira-project-<key>-owners) by default; allow override via /assign-group. I'll add a short spreadsheet with mappings.

Maria Gomez - Compliance (2026-03-12): Reviewing retention label implications. Quick note: auto-creating Confluence pages that contain customer-identifying info requires redact checks. Ensure bot has a step to warn creators to avoid PII before creating page.
Ethan Cole (2026-03-12): Understood. Will add a pre-create validation step that searches for email patterns and flags creator to confirm. Outlining required scopes and a test plan next.
Priya Nair (2026-03-12): I'll coordinate a 30-minute sync with Platform DX and Security to sign off on the pre-create validation and retention label. Targeting approval by 2026-03-19.
follow_up_actions: Schedule 30m sign-off meeting with Platform DX and Security
Create scoped service account and OAuth app for bot in test workspace
